chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(2n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: knapsack(W=4, val=[5, 3, 3], wt=[3, 2, 2]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
def f(i, c): (best from the first i items, capacity c)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=0, c=1)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=1, c=2)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=2, c=2)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=1, c=0)

chapters.title: Top-down memo

frames.caption: Top-down memo — O(n·W) time, O(n·W) extra space. Input: knapsack(W=4, val=[5, 3, 3], wt=[3, 2, 2]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=0, c=1)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=1, c=2)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=2, c=2)
best = max(best, val[i - 1] + f(i - 1, c - wt[i - 1])) — calls f(i=1, c=0)
